title: Perfect morning in Barcelona with Andreas
text: We had an awesome morning with Andreas! He is very interesting and knowledgeable, and we learned a lot about the history but also current daily life in Barcelona. He took us to places we would have never found/gone on our own (with less people too!), and the best part is, we have amazing photos as a souvenir. Gracias, Andreas!!
author: Lori_G

title: My first time doing this...
text: My first time doing this kind of tour during my solo trip to Barcelona and Andrea made the experience great. I was only in the city for a day, but we were able to work around my schedule and he advised on when we should meet to take advantage of the best lighting in the city. The pictures turned out great! The tour itself was very insightful and included a mixture of more touristy areas and quieter local spots that were hidden around the corners. I really enjoyed learning more about the history of the city through each of the spots we visited and the deep, complex history that shape the city a
author: Ahmed_I

title: Best decision ever (especially for solo traveller)
text:
Andreas is a kind and lovely person and very professional, both his knowledge about the city and his skill in photography. He had been patient in explaining the different places (bit of background history) and he took me to some secret places at the side streets, where you could see a different perspective of this place. 

Surely, the beautiful pictures he captured for me is a highlight as well, as I was travelling solo, it is hard to get pictures taken in such occasion when you are alone.  Highly recommended to everyone who visits Barcelona. 

Thank you Andreas and I hope when I back in Barce
author: Sin Lun L

title: Highly Recommend! Beautiful Tour and Photos!
text: I had such a great time touring with Andreas. I appreciated the intimacy of the tour. Andreas was very knowledgeable about the sites we visited, and the photoshoot aspect was a lot of fun. I'm happy with both my tour experience and the final photos. Highly recommend taking advantage of this opportunity while you're in Barcelona! You won't regret it!
author: shamekaj899

title: Barcelona Memories
text: We enjoyed the photos and the tour of the city.  We were able to see many out of the way places as well as the “hot spots”.  It was a relaxed photo shoot and we are very happy with the experience.  Highly recommended!
author: Randall_M

title: Enchanting Barcelona Tour and Photo Shoit
text: We loved the one on one experience we had with Martina! Her insight and knowledge of the history was fantastic! We had so much fun and we can’t wait to see our pictures. She gave us a perspective of the city that was so enchanting. Thank you Martina♥️
author: ijmm24

title: Strike a POSE!
text: Had an amazing time with Martina taking fun shots at iconic places within Barcelona! The added bonus were the young ladies who joined us during the tour. It was definitely a family affair vibe❤️ A must do while in Barcelona.
author: Anonymous

title: MUST DO!!! Fantastic tour and beautiful photos!!!
text:
Andreas was amazing!!! This was so much better than I expected for the price!! I got a full tour all over Barcelona and he took such beautiful pictures that I will cherish forever!!! title: A great couple of hours
text: Andreas was friendly, polite and very knowledgeable about the places we visited in Old Barcelona. I saw places I would not have seen if I hadn’t taken this tour.
author: Gabriel_H

title: Extraordinary!
text: Our guide was amazing! He was knowledgeable, kind, and very interesting. We felt like we had made a friend when it was over.
